about: Quests changed by hand (owner, 23.11.2026: «Все квесты, которые мы обновляем вот так вручную, вносим изменения, помечай. И при обновлениях из базы их не трогай»). Every catalog build marks them (`manualCorrection`), and the data generators (scripts/quest-guide-photos.mjs, scripts/quest-grid-snapshot.mjs, scripts/update-story-index.mjs) keep their entries as they are. A new hand fix of a quest is added here with its date. `objectives`: the game's ids of the objectives a fix is written under. The owner's edits in the quest editor (server: quest_point_overrides, quest_text_overrides, quest_requirement_overrides) are stored apart and laid over every build.
